bestiary_menu.doc: The bestiary menu (M2-UI-02; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Bestiary). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference. 'list' is a MenuPage metrics block (the same keys as battle_hud.json commands). 'page': the page panel; portrait_size is the square creature portrait at its top right (M2-MNU-302), portrait_gap the space between it and the words; the words keep the rest of the inner width (pad both sides), which must hold the page's widest line in the pseudo-locale at 130% text (the English stat row needs about 690 px at 100%, so 184 + 20 leaves 692; test_pseudo_loc_screens checks the pseudo-locale).
